summary: Tested project isolation for inventory, purchasing and manufacturing (backend + frontend). Backend: 15 of 16 pytest tests pass. Strict per-project lists work for raw/manufactured/packaging/suppliers/mfg-inventory/warehouse-transfers/purchases-new/purchases-report/inventory-stats/inventory-movements. Creating items with X-Project-Id tags project_id for raw, packaging, supplier, purchase and manufacturing request. The full flow inside one project passes with no 500s: add-stock, warehouse-to-manufacturing, manufacturing request create and fulfill, manufactured product create and produce, branch request create and fulfill. The move and transfer tools pass: decrement, add to the same-named item, merge on the second transfer, 400 when qty is too high / same project / bad kind / qty 0, the log entry, and project_transfer_in/out movements in both projects. One backend failure: GET /api/warehouse-purchase-requests is not isolated. Frontend: the project bar and the move/transfer dialog work. The UI transfer of 2 kg salon→مشروع رابع worked with a toast. Badges show under 'all'. Switching project reloads the cards (all 6/99/4 → salon 1/0/0). Add dialogs show the red required field, and choosing a project switches the page and shows the locked 'المشروع: X'. Saving under 'all' is blocked with a toast. Two frontend issues: the request-materials dialog has no project field, and /reports/price-increases has no project bar.

critical.issue: Not project-isolated. server.py:11233 has an unscoped @api_router.get('/warehouse-purchase-requests'). api_router is included at server.py:18503, before inventory_router at :18523, so the server.py route shadows the scoped route in inventory_system.py:2549. A request created with X-Project-Id=P4 (tagged P4 in the DB) is returned with X-Project-Id=SALON. It also ignores the ?status filter. Fix: delete the server.py duplicate or scope it.

minor.issue: The same route-shadowing problem: server.py api_router copies (server.py:11277, :11436) take precedence over the scoped inventory_system ones, so packaging requests are NOT project-isolated. Found by code review and route diff; not exercised through the API.

The 'last number' is found with a scoped find_one(sort=...), which only sees the project's own docs plus untagged ones. Numbers now restart per project, giving duplicate #1, #2 across projects in one tenant. Confirmed in the UI (TEST requests got #1 and #2 in REST). Acceptable if per-project numbering is intended; otherwise use the unscoped db for counters.

update_one/update_many/delete_*/find_one_and_update pass through unscoped. This is fine for id-based ops but means a project-scoped user could modify another project's item by id. Consider a lenient condition on writes too.

ui_bugs.component: WarehouseManufacturing request-materials dialog (طلب مواد خام من المخزن, line ~7805)
ui_bugs.issue: InventoryProjectField is missing. It was inserted into the recipe sync-preview dialog by mistake (line 4870, data-testid sync-preview-dialog). Under 'كل المشاريع' the user cannot pick a project, so POST /manufacturing-requests is blocked by the interceptor and there is no way to fix it from the dialog. The materials list also shows every project's materials.

integration_issues.issue: No PageProjectBar and no useProject dependency. It is scoped only by whatever is in localStorage when the page loads; the user cannot switch project and the page does not reload when the project changes.

issues: The project bar renders above the page header (with a dark strip at the top) instead of under it like the other pages
Page title 'تقرير زيادة أسعار الشراء' and the back button have very low contrast on the dark header background
The target project select appears to include the currently selected source project (not verified). Picking it in transfer mode leads to a 400 error.

action_items: Remove or scope the duplicate GET /warehouse-purchase-requests in server.py (shadows the scoped route) and also the duplicate packaging-requests and branch-packaging-inventory routes in server.py
Move <InventoryProjectField /> from the sync-preview dialog (WarehouseManufacturing.js ~4870) to the request-materials dialog (~7805)
Add PageProjectBar plus a useProject/selectedProjectId refetch dependency to PriceIncreaseReport.js
Optional: decide whether request/transfer numbering per project is intended; exclude the current project from the move/transfer target list
critical_code_review_comments: Route duplication between server.py api_router and routes/inventory_system.py: whichever router is included first wins, so the new scoping is silently skipped for 6 routes
The ContextVar scope is set by a router dependency. Routes in server.py call set_inventory_scope manually, so any future inventory route added to server.py will be unscoped unless it does the same
server.py purchase-invoices does a supplier find_one for each invoice in a loop (N+1)

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all pages have the bar and reload except price-increases; 6/7 warehouse dialogs have the field)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iv*/TEST_ui* raw materials, products, packaging, suppliers, requests, transfers, movements and logs; all were cleaned from the DB after testing. Seeded data is unchanged.

The request-materials button is on tab-manufacturing (data-testid request-materials-btn).
rca of the issue: warehouse-purchase-requests leak: FastAPI matches routes in registration order. app.include_router(api_router) at server.py:18503 registers server.py's unscoped GET /api/warehouse-purchase-requests before inventory_router at :18523, so the scoped handler is never reached. Reproduce: POST /api/warehouse-purchase-requests with X-Project-Id=P4, then GET with X-Project-Id=SALON; the request is returned. Mitigation: delete the server.py duplicate route.
